_meta.note: The limits are per room, not relay-wide. With five legitimate marks already present, 61 posts evict all five legitimate marks and the first spam mark rather than being refused. This fixture documents within-room replacement only; rotating invented keys creates a separate unbounded cross-room growth case.

scenario.modeledEffect: Five existing plus 61 rapid posts produces 66 insertions against a per-room cap of 60. Oldest-first eviction removes the 5 pre-existing legitimate waypoints and the first spam waypoint, leaving 60 spam entries — the squad's actual plan is gone.
scenario.globalBound: None. GroupMarks has no global room or waypoint cap, and seven-day waypoint pruning runs only when persisted state is loaded.
